claim: Local automated ordinary +inventory/+party/+use/+deposit command/model acceptance using captured session transport and real disposable PostgreSQL; setup is separate.
scope: twelve existing vitamin/feather items through one field effect and shared fresh target transaction
reuse EV validators and stat helpers with +10/+1 amounts and 252/510 caps
useful partial increases only; atomic inventory/EV/HP writes with cache rollback and concurrency checks
help, stat-to-item support table, production-command SQL tests and lifecycle CI

rules.partial_gain: min(item amount, remaining stat capacity, remaining total capacity)
rules.invalid_saved_evs: Reject before debit; do not normalize or repair
rules.useful_gain: A positive EV increase consumes one copy even if displayed-stat rounding hides the change
rules.hp: Same as EV berries: fainted stays zero; living HP = clamp(old HP + new max - old max, 1, new max)

rule_review: The official supplement policy allows vitamins to reach maximum base points rather than the old 100-EV threshold. The existing PF2 item callbacks already specify +10 vitamins and +1 feathers; existing validators/stats enforce 252 per stat and 510 total. The new field route applies those values with useful-effect and persistence checks, preserving the existing EV-berry HP convention.
source_hash_format: SHA-256 of UTF-8 normalized LF text; verified against staged and committed blobs before publication.

setup_and_cleanup.fixture_setup: Fresh private loopback PostgreSQL, isolated schemas, tagged ordinary User owners, canonical slot-3 level-100 Mew, calculated HP/stats and real Trainer.add_item stock. SQL setup deliberately leaves stale cached models; active move slots retain gaps 1/4.
setup_and_cleanup.transport_adapters: Capture session messages and delegate production User storage/inventory behavior. Production command parser/func, target/lock/transaction, EV validation, stat helpers, placement and SQL writers run normally. No successful training effect is mocked.
setup_and_cleanup.failure_injection: Failed debit (false without write and false after real SQL debit), exception after real Pokemon UPDATE; assert unchanged full SQL, inventory/cache and calculated stats. Worker threads use independent synchronized PostgreSQL connections.
setup_and_cleanup.cleanup: All disposable schemas removed, public schema empty and private task cluster stopped; no existing DB, human character, service or migration runner used.
